known: You know exactly where you stand. [[card]] Your household is in the [[group]] today and would be in the [[group]] under any of the plans. Whichever plan is chosen, that is the group whose income you will have.
lottery: For the length of the convention, no delegate has a place in the country. When it ends, each delegate's household will be placed in one of the five groups by a fair lottery, drawn separately for each delegate, with a one-in-five chance of each group. You will then live under whatever was chosen, with the income of the group you draw. Every delegate is in this same position.
withheld: Your household has a definite place in the country, in one of the five groups, but for the length of the convention every delegate's knowledge of their own place has been withheld. You do not know which group you are in, what work you do, what you own, your age, your health or your abilities. You also cannot work out the odds. Delegates were not drawn at random from the population and you have been told nothing about how they were chosen, so the fact that each group holds a fifth of households says nothing about which one is yours. When the convention ends your knowledge returns, and you will live under whatever was chosen, with the income of the group that is yours. Every delegate is in this same position.
